blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine transport technology provider Global Electric Transport (GET) aims to triple its electric bus fleet by year-end to meet increased demand for electric vehicles, deploying these units on public routes and corporate shuttles. GET operates the Community Organized Managed Electric Transport (Comet), which is a China-made electric minibus. The company uses these vehicles for its public “Love Bus” service and shuttle operations for major multinational companies in the country.
